# Progressive enhancement

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

A design philosophy that gives a baseline of essential content and functions to as many users as possible, and a richer experience to the browsers that run all the required code. GOV.UK requires each government service to follow progressive enhancement, and to work with HTML only.
